separate_p256_acceptance.limit: The initial full attempt failed through ambient dependency routing. Corrected project-root capture rejected two missing objects before HOL. After their isolated build, full replay reached the entrypoint equivalence proof but timed out at P256_MONTJADD_EQUIV after 1815.268 seconds (1800-second requested budget plus controller allowance and cleanup). No target was nonce-probed as proved; 11 printed values remain unverified and six target bindings are missing. No theorem falsity follows from this timeout.

limits: The full functional target retains alignment, range, memory-separation and machine-state premises.
A completed explicit basis can be reused only with its exact source, dependency, ELF, shelf and backend identities; every target replay still starts in a fresh child.
Zero new axioms is a delta from the admitted warm basis, not an inventory or audit of pre-existing axioms.
Small lifecycle controls validate refusals and cache behavior; they do not replace substantial assembly acceptance.
Installer smoke tests are installation checks, not evidence that substantial assembly authoring succeeds.
